entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
National has promised to help households shift to solar power through low interest loans, if it's re-elected | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1
 
It planned to introduce a Home Energy Fund offering low-interest, long-term loans that are repaid through rates so households can invest in solar, batteries, insulation and heat pumps, without big upfront costs.
 
The party would also allow people to install solar without the need for council consent.
 
Read more: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/politics/620500/national-promises-homeowners-low-cost-loans-to-install-solar-power
